test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A 315 - m - long train is moving at a speed of 24 km/h. It will cross a man coming from the opposite direction at a speed of 3 km/h in __________.
solution:
**Given:**

Lenght of train = 315m

Speed of train = 24km/h

Speed of man = 3km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Relative speed = Addition of speeds if moving in opposite direction.

**Solution:**

Relative speed of man and train = 24 + 3 = 27km/h

27km/h = 27000m/(60x 60)s = 7.5m/s

**Now, time to cover the distance = 315/7.5 = 42 seconds.**
